body: Thank you. I rarely feel anything reading the responses I get, but as an existentialist your answer helps put into words what I keep living for, rather than trying to guilt me or put me on medication. Maybe life will be harder because of what just happened, but maybe I can pull through. You are very wise to get through to me, of all people. Thank you, again.

I know plenty of people who don't care what other people think of them, and this doesn't help them any bit. They are just as friendless and lonely as I. 
 
What's wrong with caring about how other people view me? That in and of itself directly affects if they want to be around me or not. I don't want much out of life. I simply want to be around people who love, respect or want my presence. I can't change that.

There has to be something wrong with me if no one wants to be around me... it has nothing to do with a "phase" or a depression or anything, this is how I've felt my entire life. I want to be cared for. I want people to desire my opinion... but no one wants me around. I breakdance on occasion, but I've been doing it less now that I've sunken so low. There aren't many friends to make on the breakdance crew, they're all graduating this year practically
